defer_conditions.Pregnant or breastfeeding: Out of segment and most actives lack safety data — do not sell any plan.
defer_conditions.Recent surgery: Anti-inflammatory and bleeding-risk actives are paused peri-operatively — do not sell until the surgeon clears it.

sleep.label: Sleep quality
sleep.why: Needs at least two calming/sleep-active ingredients or the box does nothing for sleep.

energy.label: Energy & vitality
energy.why: Needs at least two energy-pathway actives.

heart.label: Heart health
heart.why: Omega-3 and CoQ10 are the mechanism; without two of these it is not a heart plan.

brain.label: Brain & memory
brain.why: Cognition rests on citicoline plus omega-3/B12.

joints.label: Joints & mobility
joints.why: Needs an anti-inflammatory (curcumin or omega-3) AND a structural active (collagen or creatine). Losing all anti-inflammatories makes it a joint box that cannot relieve joint pain.

longevity.label: Longevity
longevity.why: Broad plan — needs most of its base intact to justify the price.

digestion.label: Digestion & gut
digestion.why: Without a probiotic or enzymes it is not a digestion plan.

stress.label: Stress & mood
stress.why: Needs at least two calming actives.
